statement.en: This level is set in Kingston. Discover Canada names Fort Henry at Kingston as part of a costly defence system that Britain paid for, and says it is a popular historic site today.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Kingston. Découvrir le Canada nomme le fort Henry, à Kingston, parmi les défenses coûteuses payées par la Grande-Bretagne, et dit que c'est aujourd'hui un lieu historique populaire.

source.quote: The British paid for a costly Canadian defence system, including the Citadels at Halifax and Québec City, the naval drydock at Halifax and Fort Henry at Kingston—today popular historic sites.

verification.evidence: By 1814, the American attempt to conquer Canada had failed. The British paid for a costly Canadian defence system, including the Citadels at Halifax and Québec City, the naval drydock at Halifax and Fort Henry at Kingston—today popular historic sites.

blurb.en: Britain paid for a costly system of defences in Canada. Fort Henry at Kingston was part of it. Today it is a popular historic site.
blurb.fr: La Grande-Bretagne a payé un coûteux système de défense au Canada. Le fort Henry, à Kingston, en faisait partie. C'est aujourd'hui un lieu historique populaire.

blurb.en: In 1840, Upper Canada and Lower Canada were joined together. They became one province, the Province of Canada.
blurb.fr: En 1840, le Haut-Canada et le Bas-Canada ont été réunis. Ils sont devenus une seule province, la province du Canada.

source.quote: In 1840, Upper and Lower Canada were united as the Province of Canada.

verification.evidence: In 1840, Upper and Lower Canada were united as the Province of Canada.

blurb.en: The Duke of Wellington chose Bytown, which is Ottawa today, as the end point of the Rideau Canal. The canal was part of a network of forts. It was meant to stop the United States from invading Canada again.
blurb.fr: Le duc de Wellington a choisi Bytown, aujourd'hui Ottawa, comme point d'arrivée du canal Rideau. Le canal faisait partie d'un réseau de forts. Il devait empêcher les États-Unis d'envahir le Canada de nouveau.

source.quote: The Duke of Wellington sent some of his best soldiers to defend Canada in 1814. He then chose Bytown (Ottawa) as the endpoint of the Rideau Canal, part of a network of forts to prevent the U.S.A. from invading Canada again.

verification.evidence: The Duke of Wellington sent some of his best soldiers to defend Canada in 1814. He then chose Bytown (Ottawa) as the endpoint of the Rideau Canal, part of a network of forts to prevent the U.S.A. from invading Canada again.

blurb.en: Canada's flag has a red, white and red pattern. That pattern comes from the flag of the Royal Military College in Kingston. The college was founded in 1876.
blurb.fr: Le drapeau du Canada a un motif rouge, blanc et rouge. Ce motif vient du drapeau du Collège militaire royal, à Kingston. Le collège a été fondé en 1876.

source.quote: A new Canadian flag was raised for the first time in 1965. The red-white-red pattern comes from the flag of the Royal Military College, Kingston, founded in 1876.

verification.evidence: A new Canadian flag was raised for the first time in 1965. The red-white-red pattern comes from the flag of the Royal Military College, Kingston, founded in 1876.
